post.instagram_caption:
He ran a billion dollar black market, and the FBI couldn't find him.

Ross Ulbricht ran Silk Road as "Dread Pirate Roberts", hidden behind Tor and paid in Bitcoin. IRS agent Gary Alford searched for the oldest mention of the site online and found a user called altoid. In one old forum post, altoid had left his real Gmail address.

He was arrested at a San Francisco library in October 2013, sentenced to life in 2015 and pardoned in January 2025.

The last mistake: one email he typed two years earlier.

Sources: court records via Wikipedia, the original Bitcointalk post.
